name_zh: 雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安
core_mode: M540 新奥斯曼主义/正义发展党治理/司法改革/媒体控制/叙利亚干预/经济发展
intellectual_tradition: 新奥斯曼主义/伊斯兰保守民主/经济发展实用主义/强人政治
description_zh: 雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安 (1954年2月26日— ) 是土耳其政治人物，2003年至2014年担任总理，2014年起担任总统。他创立了正义与发展党 (AKP)，执政土耳其超过二十年，是中东地区在位最久的国家领导人之一。其政治核心包括：新奥斯曼主义外交——将土耳其影响力从巴尔干、中东延伸至北非和中亚，通过利比亚干预、叙利亚军事行动和东地中海油气勘探重塑地区秩序；伊斯兰保守民主——打破凯末尔主义世俗精英体制，放松头巾禁令，推动宗教自由；司法改革与总统制转型——2017年公投通过行政体制改革，取消总理职位，建立强总统制；媒体控制——2016年未遂政变后大规模清洗并接管反对派媒体，将土耳其媒体集中度推至欧洲最高水平；叙利亚政策——支持叙利亚反对派、打击库尔德武装、在利比亚和纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫介入冲突；经济发展——执政初期通过新自由主义改革实现年均8%增长，基础设施大规模建设（机场、桥梁、隧道），但后期遭遇里拉危机和高通胀。2016年未遂政变后，其权力进一步集中，通过紧急状态清洗数十万公务员和军人。2023年在大选第二轮险胜，连任至第五个总统任期。
description_en: Recep Tayyip Erdoğan (born February 26, 1954) is a Turkish politician who has served as Prime Minister (2003-2014) and President (2014-) of Turkey. He founded the Justice and Development Party (AKP) and has ruled for over twenty years, making him one of the longest-serving national leaders in the Middle East. His political core encompasses: neo-Ottoman foreign policy—extending Turkish influence from the Balkans and Middle East to North Africa and Central Asia through Libyan intervention, Syrian military operations, and Eastern Mediterranean energy exploration; Islamic conservative democracy—breaking the Kemalist secular elite system, lifting headscarf bans, promoting religious freedom; judicial reform and presidential transformation—a 2017 referendum approved administrative restructuring that abolished the prime minister post and established a strong presidential system; media control—massive purge and takeover of opposition media after the 2016 failed coup, pushing Turkey's media concentration to Europe's highest levels; Syria policy—supporting Syrian opposition forces, targeting Kurdish militias, and intervening in Libya and Nagorno-Karabakh; economic development—initial neoliberal reforms achieving 8% annual growth, massive infrastructure construction (airports, bridges, tunnels), but later encountering lira crisis and high inflation. After the 2016 failed coup, his power further consolidated through state of emergency purges affecting hundreds of thousands. In 2023, he narrowly won the runoff election, beginning his fifth presidential term.
reason_zh: 核心思维模式：M540（新奥斯曼主义/正义发展党治理/司法改革/媒体控制/叙利亚干预/经济发展）。埃尔多安体现了从伊斯兰保守政党领袖到强总统的转型路径。他通过新奥斯曼主义外交将土耳其地区影响力从巴尔干扩展至北非和中亚，利用历史遗产构建跨区域战略同盟。他打破了凯末尔主义世俗精英对政治的垄断，将伊斯兰保守价值观与经济发展实用主义相结合，创造了独特的'伊斯兰保守民主'模式。2017年行政体制改革建立总统制是其政治工程的核心成果。2016年未遂政变后的大规模清洗巩固了其权力基础，同时实施了欧洲最高水平的媒体集中控制。在叙利亚和利比亚的军事干预展现了新奥斯曼主义的现实投射，而早期的经济高速增长则体现了发展型国家模式的土耳其版本。
reason_en: Core thinking modes: M540 (Neo-Ottomanism/Justice and Development Party Governance/Judicial Reform/Media Control/Syria Intervention/Economic Development). Erdoğan embodies the transformation path from Islamic conservative party leader to strong president. He extended Turkey's regional influence from the Balkans to North Africa and Central Asia through neo-Ottoman foreign policy, leveraging historical legacy to build cross-regional strategic alliances. He broke the Kemalist secular elite's monopoly on politics, combining Islamic conservative values with economic development pragmatism to create a unique 'Islamic conservative democracy' model. The 2017 administrative reform establishing the presidential system was the core achievement of his political engineering. The massive purges after the 2016 failed coup consolidated his power base while implementing Europe's highest level of media concentration. Military interventions in Syria and Libya demonstrated the realistic projection of neo-Ottomanism, while early economic growth exemplified Turkey's version of the developmental state model.
steps_zh: 第1步：新奥斯曼思维法——地区秩序重塑：从历史帝国遗产出发，识别土耳其在地中海、巴尔干、中东和北非的战略利益交汇点
第2步：政党治理思维法——伊斯兰保守民主：打破凯末尔主义世俗精英体制，以宗教保守价值观结合经济实用主义构建执政基础
第3步：制度变革思维法——总统制转型：通过2017年公投推动行政体制改革，取消总理职位，建立强总统制框架
第4步：危机应对思维法——未遂政变后的权力巩固：利用2016年政变危机实施大规模清洗，重建安全与情报体系
第5步：地缘博弈思维法——叙利亚/利比亚干预：以军事和外交手段投射地区影响力，平衡北约、俄罗斯和中东各方利益
steps_en: Step 1: Neo-Ottoman Thinking Method - Regional order reshaping: identifying Turkey's strategic interests across the Mediterranean, Balkans, Middle East and North Africa through historical imperial legacy

Step 2: Party Governance Thinking Method - Islamic conservative democracy: breaking the Kemalist secular elite system, building ruling foundation by combining religious conservative values with economic pragmatism

Step 3: Institutional Reform Thinking Method - Presidential transformation: pushing administrative restructuring through 2017 referendum, abolishing the prime minister post, establishing strong presidential framework
Step 4: Crisis Response Thinking Method - Power consolidation post-coup attempt: using the 2016 coup crisis to implement massive purges, rebuilding security and intelligence apparatus
Step 5: Geopolitical Gaming Thinking Method - Syria/Libya intervention: projecting regional influence through military and diplomatic means, balancing NATO, Russia and Middle Eastern interests
expected_zh: 将土耳其从地区大国重塑为跨区域的战略力量（新奥斯曼主义）
建立伊斯兰保守价值观与经济发展并行的执政模式
完成从议会制到总统制的政治体制转型
在叙利亚和利比亚建立土耳其主导的安全秩序
实现大规模基础设施建设和经济现代化（后期面临通胀危机）
expected_en: Transform Turkey from regional power to cross-regional strategic force (neo-Ottomanism)
Establish ruling model combining Islamic conservative values with economic development
Complete political transition from parliamentary system to presidential system
Establish Turkey-led security order in Syria and Libya
Achieve massive infrastructure construction and economic modernization (later facing inflation crisis)
case_zh: 1954年出生于伊斯坦布尔费内尔区；1994年当选伊斯坦布尔市长；1998年因朗读宗教诗歌被监禁六个月；2001年创立正义与发展党 (AKP)；2003年担任总理，开启长期执政；2011-2015年AKP连续三次大选获胜，巩固权力基础；2013年遭盖齐公园抗议冲击但成功镇压；2014年成为土耳其首位直选总统；2016年7月15日未遂军事政变后宣布紧急状态，清洗数十万公务员、军人和教师；2017年公投通过行政体制改革取消总理职位，建立总统制；2018年就任首任总统制下的总统；在叙利亚支持反对派、打击YPG、2019年进攻曼比季；2020年介入利比亚内战支持民族团结政府；2023年在选举第二轮险胜基利奇达尔奥卢连任，开启第五个总统任期。
case_en: Born in Fatih district, Istanbul 1954; elected Mayor of Istanbul 1994; imprisoned six months in 1998 for reciting a religious poem; founded the Justice and Development Party (AKP) in 2001; became Prime Minister 2003, beginning extended rule; AKP won three consecutive elections (2011-2015), consolidating power base; survived Gezi Park protests 2013 but crushed them; became Turkey's first directly elected President 2014; failed military coup on July 15, 2016 followed by mass purges of hundreds of thousands of civil servants, military personnel and teachers; 2017 referendum approved administrative reform abolishing PM post, establishing presidential system; inaugurated as first president under new system 2018; supported Syrian opposition, targeted YPG, invaded Manbij 2019; intervened in Libyan civil war 2020 supporting GNA; narrowly won runoff election against Kılıçdaroğlu in 2023, beginning fifth presidential term.
